title: Claudio Valente quits his job and vanishes

tellings.quote: One day in 2013, Valente reported to work. He declared it would be his last day.

plain: One day in 2013, a man named Claudio Valente went to work at SAPO in Portugal, announced it would be his last day, and then disappeared, according to Michels. Michels tells it himself, citing a man named Sergio Bastos, in an episode about scientists who have gone missing. If true, it would add Valente to a pattern of skilled people vanishing without explanation.
